# Pinned KiCad footprints

[Project overview](../../README.md) · [Documentation](../../docs/README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

The small footprint set used by this project, kept local so the source remains reproducible.

## Audited parts

| Footprint | Basis |
|---|---|
| Wieson AC2800-0011-022-H0 | Native NVIDIA J47 lands; [audit](../../research/j47-footprint-audit.md) |
| Assmann A-DS 09 A/KG-T2S | Manufacturer drill/row/shell dimensions applied to KiCad geometry |
| XFCN PZ254V-11-02P | Exact 1.02 mm drill and 2.54 mm pitch |
| SOT-23, mounting holes and fiducials | Pinned KiCad library geometry |
| Samtec SHF-113 | Alternative candidate only; not the default J1 or an approved Wieson substitute |

Shared connector work is proposed in [KiCAD_Libs PR4](https://github.com/mvalancy/KiCAD_Libs/pull/4). These standalone KiCad derivatives retain their accompanying library licenses and design exception. See [third-party notices](../../THIRD_PARTY.md). Manufacturer-certified 3D models and received-part fit remain separate evidence.
